main.description: Get the posts that quote a private-tier post (tools.kryphocron.feed.postPrivate) that the requester is authorized to read, newest first: private posts quoting it that the requester may read, as #privatePostView, and community members' public posts quoting it, by authors with no block either way with the requester, as #publicPostRef. A public quoting post is given by reference only: hydrate it through a public AppView. Each item carries its $type. The post is read for the requester as getPosts reads it; a post the requester may not read, one that does not exist and a URI that names no private post all give the same answer, {uri, posts: []}. Requires auth by a ready community member.

cursor.description: Opaque, sealed pagination cursor from a previous response to the same requester for the same uri. Any other cursor is rejected with InvalidRequest.
Present whenever more candidates remain. A page reads at most twice its `limit` in candidates. It can be short or empty and still carry a cursor; keep paging while a cursor is present.

degraded.description: Present and true while this AppView is degraded: a relay it reads private posts from is behind, so posts may be missing for now and should not be shown as deleted. Absent otherwise. The same for every requester at a given moment.

retryAfter.description: With degraded: seconds to wait before asking again (also sent as the Retry-After header).

unavailable.description: The requester's own private posts this response read and could not serve yet, each once; absent when none. Never names another account's post.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.

errors.name: Reindexing
errors.description: The caller's account is being re-indexed after an interruption; retry after `retryAfter` seconds (in the body; also the Retry-After header). Not NotReady: the caller is still a member.
